Source: step 1 (Gap) of the parent-supplied proof of idtp_cse_flux_density_eq, together with the fact (Supp) used there. Notation as in the statement; spt C = C.support and spt μ = μ.support (Measure.support: the points all of whose neighbourhoods have positive μ-measure).
1. (spt C = spt μ.) ℝ^P = univ is open and R represents C, so the sibling support_eq (the accepted theorem Submission.imrep_represents_support_eq_inter_measure_support, applied with n = 2, U = univ, T = C, isOpen_univ and R.Represents C) gives C.support = univ ∩ R.measure.support; with Set.univ_inter, spt C = spt μ.
2. (μ is carried by its support.) ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P) is second countable, hence hereditarily Lindelöf (Mathlib instance SecondCountableTopology.toHereditarilyLindelof), so MeasureTheory.Measure.support_mem_ae gives μ.support ∈ ae μ: μ-a.e. x lies in spt μ, hence by step 1 in spt C.
3. (Pointwise dichotomy.) Let x ∈ spt C satisfy ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s and |f(x)| < s. If 2s|x| < |q(x)|, the second alternative holds. Otherwise |q(x)| ≤ 2s|x|, and Loc(s) applied with s' := s (admissible because 0 < s and s ≤ s) to x — all of its hypotheses x ∈ spt C, ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s, |f(x)| < s and |q(x)| ≤ 2s|x| hold — yields |q(x)| < (s/4)|x| (first component of its conclusion). Since s > 0 and |x| ≥ 0, (s/4)|x| ≤ (s/2)|x|, so |q(x)| < (s/2)|x|, the first alternative.
4. Filtering the a.e. statement of step 2 through step 3 (filter_upwards) gives the claim for μ-a.e. x. ∎
